messages:
incidentbot: :warning: PagerDuty alert fired: service=runtime-proxy latency_p90 > 1200ms (auto-resolved)

pagerduty: Incident #PD-212345 triggered by runtime-proxy (auto-resolved)

maria.s: ack'ing briefly to confirm, oncall here

ryan.k: I see a couple of p95 spikes across proxy->backend during the window. Looks like 30s bursts. No persistent errors in traces. attaching quick logs

samira: on it — pulling the last 10m from grafana and traces. Can we confirm customer impact? I don't see any 5xx surge on edge logs.

lee_t: checked the dedicated pools: one router autoscale bounced a pod at ~1712345650, that coincides with the spike. Could be warmup + short qps blip causing latency.

maria.s: thanks. PD auto-resolve happened already. do we want to mute this rule until we tune? might be noisy.

ryan.k: agree. temporary suppress while we investigate. I'll add a narrow suppression for the next 30m scoped to the noisy proxy group.

samira: quick snapshot of metrics I used:
```
- proxy.latency.p95: baseline 180ms -> spike to 1400ms for ~18s at 1712345648
- proxy.errors.5xx: 0.02% (no change)
- backend.cpu: 65%
- router-restarts: 1 at 1712345652
```

lee_t: also saw an autoscaler event in cluster-a: scaleDown then immediate scaleUp, likely due to pod readiness probe flake. That churn can surface as transient p95 blips.

maria.s: customer-impact assessment: no major customer error reports, internal synthetic canaries showed minimal request loss; overall low customer impact. mark as no-user-impact for now. :white_check_mark:

oncall-shadow: handoff note for next oncall: we're suppressing the noisy latency alert for 30m while infra digs into readiness probe timing and autoscaler config. follow-up: consider increasing readiness timeout or smoothing scale threshold for router replicas.

ryan.k: I've created a short-lived alert suppression: ID sup-7890, scope=proxy-router-group, duration=30m. Also opened an infra ticket INF-452 for autoscaler/readiness investigation.

samira: leaving a quick remediation checklist in the ticket:
- reproduce with load test (10% traffic spike)
- inspect readiness probe logs and timeouts
- consider bumping initialDelay or successThreshold
- evaluate autoscaler cooldown window and target utilization

maria.s: nice. adding note to the runbook: under "noisy latency spikes" add item to verify recent deploys and autoscaler churn before escalating.

lee_t: i'll correlate deploys — there was a small router image push ~10m before the spike, might be unrelated but worth checking.

samira: final: mark thread resolved/monitoring. will follow up in INF-452 with root-cause analysis if we can reproduce.

maria.s: closing here — no customer impact, auto-resolved, suppression applied, infra ticket filed. ping if it recurs. :bell:
